messages.author: 6925ae2adcca2c30
messages.subject: plot.q question
parts:
I'm interested in plotting the precision matrix Q.  The documentation for plot.inla suggests that this should be returned as part of a standard plot command, but this doesn't seem to be the case, as suggested by the following:

x <- rnorm(100)
y <- 2 * x + rnorm(100, 3, 5)
d <- data.frame(x, y)
mod <- inla(y ~ x, data = d)
plot(mod)

I get the same results using plot(mod, plot.q = TRUE).

Does plot.q only work when you have a user-specified precision matrix?  Is there a way of recovering the precision matrix Q associated with the simple model given above?

Any help would be much appreciated.

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] plot.q question
parts:
On Tue, 2016-05-31 at 07:40 -0700, Adam Slez wrote:
> I'm interested in plotting the precision matrix Q.  The documentation
> for plot.inla suggests that this should be returned as part of a
> standard plot command, but this doesn't seem to be the case, as
> suggested by the following:
>
> x <- rnorm(100)
> y <- 2 * x + rnorm(100, 3, 5)
> d <- data.frame(x, y)
> mod <- inla(y ~ x, data = d)
> plot(mod)
>
> I get the same results using plot(mod, plot.q = TRUE).
>

aah, yes. you need also to tell inla() to store it. if its there, its
automatically plotted. 

H

************************

x <- rnorm(100)
y <- 2 * x + rnorm(100, 3, 5)

idx = sample(5, 100, replace=TRUE)
d <- data.frame(x, y, idx)
mod <- inla(y ~ x + f(idx), data = d,  control.compute = list(q=T))
plot(mod)



--
Håvard Rue
he...@r-inla.org

y <- 2 * x + rnorm(100, 3, 5)
idx <- rep(1:50, each = 2)

d <- data.frame(x, y, idx) 
mod <- inla(y ~ x + f(idx), data = d,

control.compute = list(q=T), 
            control.predictor = list(compute = TRUE)) 
mod$Q

Am I right in thinking that we should be expecting a 152 x 152 precision matrix here?

Adam

messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] plot.q question
parts:
Does the ones returned for each theta configuration helps?
control.compute(config=TRUE)
and you can have it in
mod$misc$configs$config

Elias

messages.author: b453c29749de564d
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] plot.q question
parts:
yes, there you have access to both Q and L (in Q=LL'). Note that only
the lower part of Q are stored.
